_about: Where the pipeline gets every {placeholder} and every 'when' condition used in screens.json and tabs.json. 'from' lists references that tests/test_words.py resolves: contract:<path in pipeline/export/schema.json> ([] = array items, * = any plan id), crops:<crop or *>.<key in config/crops.json>, field:<key in config/fields/<id>.yaml>, words:<word file>.<key path>, code:<repo file>:<function> (a value the twin computes that the contract does not carry). 'how' says how the value is made. Names (crops, months, source kinds) are filled per language from screens.json 'shared'. Numbers are written with Devanagari digits in Nepali (texts.fill). 'example' is a sample value for tests and the preview only.

guess_list.how: crop ids in season order, each named from shared.crop_names ('bare' = no crop), joined with ', then ' / ', अनि '

year_count.how: number of replay years (2001-2025 = 25); the screen title uses it instead of CLAUDE.md's '20' (owner approved, 2026-11-12, choice 1)

shift_days_abs.how: absolute value, rounded to whole days; the sign picks onset_earlier or onset_later

section.how: the number after 's' in the section id

wetness.how: rounded to a whole number, 0 to 100

temp.how: soil temperature from the probe, not air temperature (owner, 2026-11-12, choice 9), rounded to a whole degree C; shown with the source kind 'measured by the soil stick'

dry_days.how: that year's dry days (the field's own water case)

drought_years.how: count of this plan's replay years with event 'drought'

harvest_gain.how: this plan's harvest score minus the current plan's, rounded; used only when harvest_better

gain_low.how: the smallest harvest gain over the current plan when both plans are replayed with each crop at the smaller and at the larger root depth of its FAO-56 Table 22 range (rules.yaml plans.gain_range), rounded

gain_high.how: the largest harvest gain over the same runs, rounded

cover_days_gain.how: this plan's days with a crop in a year minus the current plan's (the cover score is that share of 365 days), whole days

soil_distance.how: metres from the field to the soil-map cell used, when that is not the field's own cell (the soil data card), whole metres

first_crop.how: the crop every option of current_options grows first (the monsoon crop), named from shared.crop_names

option_a.how: the crop that only the first (default) option grows

option_b.how: the crop that only the second option grows

memory_seasons.how: the number of satellite-seen seasons the field-memory test used (build step 7b)

source_kind.how: sources[].type in plain words (model = 'worked out by computer': golden rule 8)

new_crop.how: the plan's first crop that the current plan does not have

legume_crop.how: the plan's first crop with legume true

deep_root_crop.how: the plan's crop with the largest zr_m

assumed_crop.how: the plan's crops with ky_assumed true, joined with ' and ' / ' र '

crop.how: the crop the line is about

month.how: the month the tip is about, named per language from shared.months (Nepali: the Bikram Sambat month that begins in it, with the Gregorian months beside it; owner, 2026-11-12, choice 7)

sow_month.how: month of the crop's start date, named from shared.months (Nepali: Bikram Sambat first, approximate)

harvest_month.how: month of the crop's end date, named from shared.months (Nepali: Bikram Sambat first, approximate)

future_low.how: the dial's series at future_year, rounded

future_high.how: the dial's series at future_year, rounded

rain_fix_year.how: the year the GPM break correction starts (2017 for the demo field)

water_crop.how: the plan's first crop sown in a window config/crops.json notes as irrigated (FAO Crop Calendar)

option_legume.how: the legume of the best rice plan with a legume (pipeline/plans/explain.py legume_option)

rain_before.how: mean yearly rain in the field's GPM cell over the reference years, rounded to 10 mm

rain_after.how: mean yearly rain from the break on, as published, rounded to 10 mm

rain_normal.how: DHM 1991-2020 normal of the nearest town's station (Bhaktapur), rounded to 10 mm

err_before.how: held-out mean monthly error against the airport station before the fix, whole mm

err_after.how: the same after the fix, whole mm

harvest_dhm.how: the plan's harvest score with the rain scaled to DHM Bhaktapur's 1991-2020 normals (the range's dry edge, owner's decision 4b, 2026-11-14), rounded; used only when it differs

cal_dry_down.how: 100 x (1 - rules.yaml gpm_series.gauge_calibration factors.other), from the weather card (corrections.rain_break.gauge_calibration), rounded

cal_wet_up.how: 100 x (factors.jjas - 1), from the same card, rounded

risk_years.how: years (of year_count) with at least one heavy-rain day in a crop's harvest weeks (site/data/rainrisk/<field>.json plans[].crops[].count) or with a too hot or too cold day (site/data/heatclock/<field>.json checks[].today.years_with); rules.yaml rain_risk, heat_clock

risk_low.how: the lowest count over the four rain versions (rainrisk plans[].crops[].count_low)

risk_high.how: the highest count over the four rain versions (rainrisk plans[].crops[].count_high)

dry_run_days.how: days in the longest run of days with under 1 mm of rain from a crop's sowing day to its last day (DHM's CDD, counted per crop season): the typical year (site/data/rainrisk/<field>.json plans[].crops[].dry_run.typical), a worst year (dry_run.worst[].days) or a tapped year (dry_run.years[].days); rules.yaml rain_risk.dry_spells

per_season.how: mean too hot / too cold days per season around 2040 (heatclock checks[].future.scenarios.<ssp>.median) or the same models' 1995-2014 (past_median), one decimal, passed as text

bags_low.how: whole 50 kg urea bags per hectare, low end (site/data/fertiliser/<field>.json bags_ha_whole[0]); rules.yaml fertiliser_saver

bags_high.how: whole 50 kg urea bags per hectare, high end (fertiliser bags_ha_whole[1])

next_crop.how: the crop after the legume in the safest plan (site/data/fertiliser/<field>.json next_crop), named from shared.crop_names

danger_years.how: in how many of the block's past years the danger happened (rules.yaml weather_ahead.count)

count.how: how many past winters the suggested crop did better (site/data/simple/<field>.json replay_card counts.better)

rain_word.how: the block's usual rain word (dry, some rain, wet), from words.json weather.rain_<word>

temp_word.how: the block's usual temperature word (cold, mild, warm), from words.json weather.temp_<word>

date.how: the day the field's own NASA picture on the photo step was taken (site/data/basemap/<field>.json 'date', YYYY-MM-DD), written as day, month and year (site/js/app.js fmtDate); the line is left out when that picture has no full date, and abroad, where only the world picture shows

month_from.how: the first month of Weather ahead's card when months next to each other say the same thing (site/js/app.js joinBlocks)

month_to.how: the last month of that card

plan_is_current.plain: for the plan you have now

plan_is_cover_gap.how: the plan chosen as best 'cover the gap' (CLAUDE.md 'Plans' step 4; build step 7 sets its id: 'cover_gap', owner approved 2026-11-12, choice 4)
plan_is_cover_gap.plain: for the plan that fills empty months

plan_is_follow_shift.how: the plan chosen as best 'follow the shift' (build step 7 sets its id: 'follow_shift', owner approved 2026-11-12, choice 4); not shown since owner's decision 5 (2026-11-13), kept for a revisit after step 9
plan_is_follow_shift.plain: for the plan that follows the changing rains

onset_earlier.plain: if the rains now start earlier

onset_later.plain: if the rains now start later

onset_same.plain: if the start of the rains has not moved

groundwater_falling.plain: if stored water in the area is falling

groundwater_steady.plain: if stored water in the area is steady

groundwater_rising.plain: if stored water in the area is rising

has_frost_risk.how: any month whose frost is not 'none'
has_frost_risk.plain: if some months have freezing nights

water_source_unknown.plain: if we do not know the field's water

station_rain_lower.how: the field has a validation station and data/checks/<field>/crosscheck_gpm_<station>.json gives the station 25 to 40 percent less rain than GPM over complete months (demo: GPM +41.2%, station 29% lower); the text says 'about a third'
station_rain_lower.plain: if the nearby station records about a third less rain than the satellite

field_is_placeholder.plain: while the field is a sample, not a farmer's own

new_crop.how: the plan has a crop the current plan does not
new_crop.plain: if the plan adds a crop you do not grow now

has_legume.how: any crop in the plan has legume true
has_legume.plain: if the plan has lentil or another crop that feeds the soil

breaks_family.how: no two crops in a row (round the year) share a family
breaks_family.plain: if no two crops in a row are of the same family

has_deeper_roots.how: the plan's largest zr_m is larger than the current plan's (a comparison, so no threshold is needed)
has_deeper_roots.plain: if the plan has a crop with deeper roots than now

has_assumed_ky.how: any crop in the plan has ky_assumed true
has_assumed_ky.plain: if a crop's harvest loss from thirst is our assumption

has_rice.how: any crop in the plan has paddy true
has_rice.plain: if the plan has paddy rice

harvest_better.how: rounded score above the current plan's
harvest_better.plain: if the harvest score beats the current plan

water_better.how: rounded score above the current plan's
water_better.plain: if the water score beats the current plan

cover_better.how: rounded score above the current plan's
cover_better.plain: if the ground-cover score beats the current plan

soil_better.how: rounded score above the current plan's
soil_better.plain: if the soil-kept score beats the current plan

thirsty_month.how: per crop, the month with the most days where depletion passed RAW (Ks < 1) across the rain-fed replay (build step 7); shown only at 5 or more such days a year, and never for rice (rules.yaml tips; owner's answer 5, 2026-11-13)
thirsty_month.plain: for the month a crop is most often thirsty

bare_month.how: the first month whose typical cover from the satellite is 'bare'; for a suggested plan, the first such month in which the plan's own calendar is bare too (rules.yaml tips.straw_months; owner's answer 5, 2026-11-13)
bare_month.plain: for a month when the ground is usually bare

steep_part.how: a section whose slope passes a threshold still to be sourced in rules.yaml (build step 8: TODO-VERIFY)
steep_part.plain: for a part of the field that slopes

plan_is_safest.how: plan id == 'safest': the best 10th-percentile year among the rice plans keeping today's cover (owner's decision 5, 2026-11-13)
plan_is_safest.plain: for the third plan, now called Feed your soil: rice then a pulse crop (the id stays safest; rice then wheat does better in bad years)

rain_changes_harvest.how: the plan has score_dhm_rain and its harvest differs
rain_changes_harvest.plain: if NASA's uncorrected rain gives another harvest number

rain_corrected.plain: if we lowered the rain numbers after the gauges stopped

needs_water_window.how: a crop of the plan is sown in a window whose note in config/crops.json says irrigated (and not rainfed)
needs_water_window.plain: if a crop of the plan usually needs watering here

legume_option.how: the plan is the cover-the-gap plan, it has no legume, and a rice plan with a legume exists (owner's decision 4, 2026-11-13)
legume_option.plain: if lentil after rice is worth naming as another choice

bad_years_better.how: the plan's 10th-percentile year (stability) is above the current plan's, rounded
bad_years_better.plain: if bad years hurt this plan less than the current one

harvest_gain_single.how: the gain is at least 1 and its smallest and largest value round to the same number (or no range was computed and the rounded score beats the current plan's)
harvest_gain_single.plain: if the harvest gain is one number

harvest_gain_range.how: the smallest gain rounds to at least 1 and the largest is higher
harvest_gain_range.plain: if the harvest gain runs from one number to a higher one

harvest_gain_maybe.how: the smallest gain rounds to less than 1 and the largest to at least 1
harvest_gain_maybe.plain: if the harvest may be higher or no better

has_gain_range.how: a suggested plan whose harvest gain was computed over the root-depth range (owner's answer 4, 2026-11-13)
has_gain_range.plain: for a suggested plan, to say why the gain is a range

cover_days_more.how: the plan has a crop on more days of the year than the current plan
cover_days_more.plain: if the plan keeps a crop on the ground for more days

rain_reads_high.how: the twin's mean yearly rain over the record is at least 1.25 times DHM's 1991-2020 normal of the nearest station (rules.yaml gpm_series.level_caveat_ratio; owner's answer 8, 2026-11-13)
rain_reads_high.plain: if our rain is well above the nearest town's usual rain

soil_cell_far.how: the soil-map cell used lies more than one cell (250 m) from the field (the field's own cell has no values)
soil_cell_far.plain: if the soil numbers are not from the field's own spot

groundwater_trend_clear.how: diary.groundwater.confidence is at least 0.95 (the trend test's 5% level, rules.yaml groundwater.alpha); about the wide region, never about the field (owner's answer 18, 2026-11-13)
groundwater_trend_clear.plain: if the wide area's water trend is clear

winter_crop_unconfirmed.how: the field file has current_options with more than one option: the satellite's season timing cannot tell the rotations apart and the farmer has not confirmed one (owner's answer 6, 2026-11-13)
winter_crop_unconfirmed.plain: while the farmer has not said which winter crop is grown

memory_kept.how: method.field_memory.kept is true: on held-out years the learned correction beat both the physics twin alone and 'no anomaly' (rules.yaml field_memory.keep_rule)
memory_kept.plain: if the field memory won its test and is used

memory_not_kept.plain: if the field memory did not win its test and is left out

rain_gauge_calibrated.how: the weather card's corrections.rain_break.gauge_calibration.applied is true (rules.yaml gpm_series.gauge_calibration apply, the owner's switch)
rain_gauge_calibrated.plain: if we also matched the rain to four DHM gauges

profile_NP.how: the field's country profile is Nepal's (config/countries/NP.yaml; pipeline/fetch/profiles.py)
profile_NP.plain: if the field is in Nepal
